g.text: One remainder binding merges in place, all or nothing (DR-103 part 2)
the targets come from charged copies with their cleanup
reserve one operation for the merger's work context
is a binding b stored at the level?
merger(b, targets) changes b in place:
all reservations first, then the assignments
b is unchanged, so the free map is unchanged
no copy of b and no drop of b
b is dropped, and the free map is unchanged
Before DR-103 part 2: copy b with a charged copy and
cleanup of the whole binding, merge the copy, reserve
the insert and insert the copy again. A Par remainder
merges ten field lists into one binding, so its growing
binding was copied up to ten times.
rejection: the free map is unchanged
